parts.script: A: Hey Mark, do you have any plans for the weekend?  B: Not yet! I was thinking about catching up on some reading. How about you?  A: I'm considering going hiking if the weather stays nice.  B: That sounds great! Which trail are you thinking of?  A: Probably the one at Blue Ridge Park. I’ve heard it has amazing views.  B: Yes, I’ve heard that too! Do you want some company?  A: Sure! It would be fun to go together.  B: What time do you want to leave?  A: I was thinking around 9 AM. We could pack a picnic lunch.  B: Good idea! I can bring some sandwiches and snacks.  A: Perfect! I’ll take care of the drinks. Do you have a hiking backpack?  B: Yes, I do! I’ll bring that along.  A: Awesome! I’ll text you later to finalize the details.  B: Sounds good. Looking forward to it!  A: Me too! Let’s hope for sunny weather.
